clips.title: The story
paras: Clerk Daltry is the civic record keeper stationed in Darkshire Town Hall in Duskwood. Surrounded by ledgers and registry books, he helps investigate the village's past and track down historical records, even if his archives are somewhat neglected and out of date.

While Darkshire struggles against encroaching beasts, undead horrors, and supernatural gloom, everyday civic duties fall to Clerk Daltry. Working out of the Darkshire Town Hall alongside Lord Ello Ebonlocke and the local council, Daltry maintains the town's historical ledgers, property rolls, and census data. In a region fractured by disaster, his records are among the few surviving links to the days before Grand Hamlet fell into shadow.
